summary: Both REQ-1 and REQ-2 appear to be implemented. FanVoltageFlowControlChart.tsx detects dark mode via document class and uses isDark to set the Flow control (Pa) line color (black in light, white in dark). All five chart components (TemperatureChart, CO2Chart, CoolingHeatingVentilationChart, FanVoltageFlowControlChart, TSICSensorChart) have the auto-zoom useEffect pattern using useRef to initialize to the last 24 hours of data on first load. No missing requirements found. A potential quality concern exists that isDark is computed statically at render time rather than reactively, but this does not constitute a missing requirement per the spec.

hallucinated_features.description: Drag-to-zoom (ReferenceArea) functionality with dynamic Y-axis domain clamping added to chart components
hallucinated_features.reason: The diff includes click-and-drag zoom with ReferenceArea and zoomedY state variables across chart components. This was not requested in either REQ-1 or REQ-2. File summaries suggest some of this may be pre-existing, but the presence in the modified files is noted.
